page.text:
The Axiom of Pairing provides the basic mechanism for assembling distinct
entities into a higher-order collection. Given any two sets $X$ and $Y$,
pairing asserts the existence of the unordered pair $\{X, Y\}$. When
specialized to $X = Y$, it yields the singleton set $\{X\}$, allowing any
individual set to be treated as an element of a new set.
